subject: Consolidated QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling and exec coverage
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evie Torres <evie.torres@clearwave.io>, Marco Silva <marco.silva@clearwave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling and exec coverage

Hi Evie / Marco —

Hope you had a good week. As we approach your renewal in July, we want to combine the QBR with a short roadmap demo to surface the feature areas that will impact your cost/latency roadmap. Proposed format: 45 minutes (40 demo + 5 exec Q&A) with a 15-minute optional technical deep-dive for ops.

Can you share a few slots next week that work for your PM + Eng leads and one exec (VP or Director) for the Q&A? If it helps, we can hold a single 60-minute block and split in-session.

Attached is a draft agenda — feel free to suggest edits. We also need permission to record the session (we capture the demo to produce the follow-up runbook). If you prefer not to record, we can circulate detailed notes instead.

Next steps:
- Send 2–3 candidate slots (your timezone)
- Confirm exec attendee for the 5-minute portion
- Let us know recording preference

Thanks,

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Evie Torres <evie.torres@clearwave.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Marco Silva <marco.silva@clearwave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling and exec coverage

Thanks Jasmine —

Those goals make sense. We prefer a single 60-minute block. Tentative availability next week (PDT):
- Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 5/19 11:00–12:00

For exec coverage, I can commit our Head of Product, Marco Silva, for the first 10 minutes if the agenda leads with the business impact. Our platform lead (Nora) will join the technical deep-dive if we record it.

Recording is fine on our side — please include the consent form.

One logistic ask: we have a procurement touchpoint that will need to confirm updated SSO and data retention notes before renewal. Would it be possible to include a 5-minute slide in the demo about retention defaults and audit logs?

Best,
Evie

Thanks for the quick response. Locking Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 PT for the consolidated QBR + roadmap demo (60 minutes). Agenda and two-slide retention summary attached. Recording consent form attached as requested.

Zoom link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210
